# Quick Spec: Fix "Über mich" Navigation Wrapping

## Task
Prevent the "Über mich" navigation item from wrapping to two lines by adding `white-space: nowrap` to nav links.

## Files to Modify
- `src/css/styles.css` - Add `white-space: nowrap` to `.nav-menu a` selector

## Change Details
The navigation menu item "Über mich" currently wraps to two lines because the nav links don't prevent text wrapping. Adding `white-space: nowrap` to the `.nav-menu a` CSS rule (around line 290-300) will keep all nav items on a single line.

**Before:**
```
ÜBER
MICH
```

**After:**
```
ÜBER MICH
```

## Verification
- [ ] "Über mich" displays on a single line in the navigation
- [ ] All other nav items remain properly displayed
- [ ] Navigation still works on mobile/tablet views

## Notes
- The fix is in the base `.nav-menu a` style (line ~290), not in media queries
- This will apply to all nav items, ensuring none of them wrap
